endorsements.name: Aristeidis Thallas
endorsements.label: Emulating Hypervisors; a Samsung RKP case study
endorsements.description: In this work we will be investigating the emulation of proprietary Hypervisors in the Android ecosystem under QEMU. We will be providing information about ARM virtualization extensions and demonstrating key concepts with a framework implemented to allow execution of Samsung S8 hypervisor under QEMU. Finally, fuzzing implementations under this setup will be examined. Read more
